expectations.text: Uses the app's real data-zpqa locators for the star and refresh (favourite_icon, refresh_status)
No hardcoded portal or view IDs (no 9+ digit numbers in code)
Asserts the favourite add/remove network calls (POST and DELETE on /user-views/<id>/favorite)
Checks the star state through its fav/unfav class
Checks the view appears in / disappears from the Favorite Views group
Discovers view IDs at runtime from the app's user-views response
Refresh test asserts the toolbar selections are unchanged (incl. date range topbar_calendar)
Restores the original favourite state after the test
